两百万，你当我提款机呢？

“两百万不是一笔小钱，你要这么多干什么？”

“当然有用啊，老宋，一个大老板，不会没有两百万吧？放心，等彩铃的钱到账，我马上还你。”

“不借，老子没钱！！”

宋柯怒了，直接挂断电话。

特么的老子把你签下来一毛钱没赚，还要借你两百万？！

关键是这小子的口气太差，老子坚决不借！！

听着手机传来的忙音，魏沐一点也不急。

等了三分钟，老宋发来一条短信。

“银行卡号发我。”

把银行卡号发过去，当天下午钱就到账了。

看着短信到账通知，魏沐心中一喜。

老宋人还是不错滴。

正如他所说，两百万不是一个小数字，这笔钱要好好利用。

比如各类IP的影视剧改编权，现在可是白菜价，随便买

........

两天以后，首都国际机场。

上半身白色短袖，下半身搭配一条蓝色牛仔裤。

轻装简行的魏沐从机场大厅慢慢走出来。

没过一会，便找到写有他名字的接机牌。

举着牌子的是一位年轻女孩，圆脸，长相普通，笑起来有两颗小虎牙。

“魏先生，你好，我是你的生活助理小刘，负责照顾你在京城的生活起居。”

“好。”

“我给你拿行李。”

小刘热情的接过他的行李箱，魏沐没有拒绝。

人家就是干这个工作，不让她拿只会让她多想，而且他的行李箱不重。

坐上车驶离机场，小刘忍不住看了两眼魏沐。

好帅！！

她之前跟过李雨春，这次被调过来跟着一个新人，小刘有些不甘心。

做生活助理，主要收入来源并不是工资。

实际上生活助理的工资很低，她们主要靠艺人赚钱。

艺人拍广告接代言，品牌方会送给他们不少产品试用。

有的艺人会选择把这些东西分发给身边的助理，用来收买人心。

这些东西可以自己用，也可以拿出去卖钱

李雨春很火，身上代言也很多，小刘得到不少福利。

现在突然被调过来，心里怎么可能没点怨气。

但这些怨气在见到魏沐之后，全部消失了。

调过来也挺好的，每天看到这张帅脸就满足了。

“魏先生。”

Two million, will you use me as a cash machine?

"Two million is not a small sum of money. Why do you need so much?"

"Of course it will be useful. Lao Song, a big boss, he won't be short of two million, right? Don't worry, I will pay you back as soon as the money for the ringing bell arrives."

"If you don't borrow it, I have no money!!"

Song Ke became angry and hung up the phone directly.

Damn it, I didn’t make a dime when I signed you, and I still want to lend you two million?!

The key is that this guy's tone is so bad, I won't borrow it!!

Listening to the busy signal from the phone, Wei Mu was not in a hurry at all.

After waiting for three minutes, Lao Song sent a text message.

"Send me your bank card number."

Send me your bank card number and the money will arrive in your account that afternoon.

Wei Mu felt happy when he saw the SMS arrival notification.

The old Song Dynasty people are still pretty good.

As he said, two million is not a small number, and this money should be used well.

For example, the rights to adapt film and television dramas of various IPs are now available at bargain prices, so you can buy them at will.

........

Two days later, Capital International Airport.

The upper body is white short-sleeved, and the lower body is paired with a pair of blue jeans.

Wei Mu, dressed lightly and simply, walked slowly out of the airport lobby.

After a while, I found the pick-up sign with his name on it.

The person holding the sign was a young girl with a round face, ordinary appearance, and two small tiger teeth when she smiled.

"Hello, Mr. Wei, I am your life assistant Xiao Liu. I am responsible for taking care of your daily life in the capital."

"Okay."

"I'll get your luggage."

Xiao Liu enthusiastically took his suitcase, but Wei Mu did not refuse.

This is what he does, so not letting her take it will only make her think too much, and his suitcase is not heavy.

As he got into the car and drove away from the airport, Xiao Liu couldn't help but glance at Wei Mu.

So handsome!!

She had worked with Li Yuchun before, and this time she was transferred to follow a new person. Xiao Liu was a little unwilling.

As a life assistant, the main source of income is not salary.

In fact, the salary of life assistants is very low, and they mainly rely on artists to make money.

When artists film commercials and receive endorsements, brands will give them a lot of products to try out.

Some artists will choose to distribute these things to their assistants to win people's hearts.

You can use these things yourself, or you can sell them for money

Li Yuchun is very popular and has many endorsements, and Xiao Liu has received a lot of benefits.

Now that I was suddenly transferred here, how could I not feel resentful in my heart?

But all these grievances disappeared after seeing Wei Mu.

It's good to be transferred here. I'm satisfied just seeing this handsome face every day.

"Mr. Wei."
